Smart India Hackathon 2026 · Disaster Management

Find shelter. Find safety.

AASRA is a disaster relief and rescue coordination platform that connects citizens in emergencies — floods, cyclones and other disasters — with the authorities and volunteers who can help them. Built for real-world outages, not just ideal conditions, it keeps working over basic SMS when the internet fails, which is exactly when it matters most.

It covers the full disaster cycle — proactive weather alerts before a disaster, live shelter tracking and priority rescue during one, and a safety-confirmation loop after — so no one is marked safe until they actually are.

What AASRA does

Every feature is built around one question: does this help someone get to safety faster, or help an authority know they actually did?

Live shelter map

Real-time occupancy, food, water and medicine availability across shelters, shops and health centers, with one-tap navigation to the nearest one.

Priority rescue queue

Rescue requests are scored by urgency — injury, elderly or disabled presence — so the most critical cases are triaged first, not first-come-first-served.

The safety loop

A rescue request stays open, not resolved, until the citizen confirms “I Am Safe.” No one is marked handled just because an action was logged.

Offline-first SMS alerts

Storm alerts and shelter details reach citizens by direct SMS, working over basic cellular signal with zero mobile data required.

Weather-triggered alerts

Live rainfall and wind-speed monitoring computes flood risk and proactively pushes warnings before conditions turn dangerous.

11-language & voice support

English plus 10 major Indian languages, with locale-aware voice search so language is never a barrier to getting help.

Volunteer network

Citizens can register as volunteers; authorities review and approve trusted responders before they get dashboard access.

Role-based dashboards

Separate, focused experiences — citizens get “I need help” tools, authorities get acknowledge, update and resolve controls.

Built for the full disaster cycle

Most disaster apps only cover response. AASRA is designed around risk mitigation, planning and management — before, during and after.

Before

Risk mitigation & planning

  • •Live weather monitoring computes flood-risk level for a citizen's location
  • •Proactive storm alerts pushed by email and SMS before conditions peak
  • •Volunteer network pre-registered and approved ahead of time
During

Real-time management

  • •Live shelter occupancy, food, water and medicine availability
  • •Priority-scored rescue requests, triaged automatically
  • •Offline-first design keeps working when networks degrade
After

Recovery & accountability

  • •The safety loop keeps a case open until the citizen confirms safe
  • •Response data feeds back into better planning for next time
  • •Volunteer coverage data highlights gaps for future preparedness

A native Android stack chosen for one reason: reliability when the network isn't.
